Title: Azure Monitor Logs – Log Analytics REST APIs general availability

Body.Content:
A new Log Analytics REST APIs version (2020-08-01) for OperationalInsights resource provider is generally available.

This version supports new functionalities like customer-managed keys (CMK), bring your own storage (BYOS) and consolidates the functionalities of all earlier versions including: 2015-03-20, 2015-11-01-preview, 2017-04-26-preview and 2020-03-01-preview, which was announced in June 2020.
